findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: almost_done, gate_compliance, ci_history, quick_wins, operations, needs_you, ci_queue, metrics_history, settings, left_behind, sub_issue_limit, area_suggestions · Private data: list_projects, needs_you, settings · Public sink: ci_queue · Destructive: ci_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: almost_done, gate_compliance, ci_history, quick_wins, operations, needs_you, ci_queue, metrics_history, settings, left_behind, sub_issue_limit, area_suggestions · Private data: list_projects, needs_you, settings · Public sink: ci_queue · Destructive: ci_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
